  class BatchIntent:
      schema: Literal["bakecache-batch-intent/v1"]
      contract_version: Literal["bakecache-protocol/v1"]
      mode: Literal["fixture", "real"]
      batch_id: UUID
      source_tree: Tree
      output_root: AbsPath
      batch_root: AbsPath
      batch_report_dir: AbsPath
      batch_report_path: AbsPath
      planner_inputs: PlannerInputs
      legs: list[ExecutionIntent]
      serving_gate_failures: list[ServingGateFailureWire]
      incumbent_runs: dict[Text, AbsPath]
      baseline_runs: dict[BaselineLabel, AbsPath]
      expected_candidates: list[Text]
      expected_incumbents: list[Text]
      required_baselines: list[BaselineLabel]
      bakeoff_gate: bool
      report_timeout_ns: int
      max_diagnostic_bytes: int
  
      @classmethod
      def from_json(cls, raw: object) -> Outcome[Self]:
          result = _decode(raw, cls._parse)
          if result.ok:
              try:
                  encoded = (
                      raw
                      if type(raw) is str
                      else json.dumps(raw, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, separators=(",", ":"))
                  )
                  _require(
                      len(encoded.encode("utf-8")) <= result.value.max_diagnostic_bytes,
                      "batch wire exceeds diagnostic byte admission",
                  )
              except (_InvalidError, ValueError, UnicodeError) as exc:
                  return _Rejected(False, Failure(FailureCode.CONTRACT_INVALID, str(exc)))
          return result
  
      @classmethod
      def _parse(cls, raw: object) -> Self:
          obj = _object(
              raw,
              (
                  "schema",
                  "contract_version",
                  "mode",
                  "batch_id",
                  "source_tree",
                  "output_root",
                  "batch_root",
                  "batch_report_dir",
                  "batch_report_path",
                  "planner_inputs",
                  "legs",
                  "serving_gate_failures",
                  "incumbent_runs",
                  "baseline_runs",
                  "expected_candidates",
                  "expected_incumbents",
                  "required_baselines",
                  "bakeoff_gate",
                  "report_timeout_ns",
                  "max_diagnostic_bytes",
              ),
          )
          result = cls(
              schema=_constant(obj["schema"], "bakecache-batch-intent/v1"),
              contract_version=_constant(obj["contract_version"], "bakecache-protocol/v1"),
              mode=_choice(obj["mode"], ("fixture", "real")),
              batch_id=_uuid(obj["batch_id"]),
              source_tree=_pattern(obj["source_tree"], r"[0-9a-f]{40}"),
              output_root=_path(obj["output_root"]),
              batch_root=_path(obj["batch_root"]),
              batch_report_dir=_path(obj["batch_report_dir"]),
              batch_report_path=_path(obj["batch_report_path"]),
              planner_inputs=PlannerInputs._parse(obj["planner_inputs"]),
              legs=_array(obj["legs"], ExecutionIntent._parse, False),
              serving_gate_failures=_array(obj["serving_gate_failures"], ServingGateFailureWire._parse, False),
              incumbent_runs=_map(obj["incumbent_runs"], _text),
              baseline_runs=_map(obj["baseline_runs"], lambda value: _enum(value, BaselineLabel)),
              expected_candidates=_array(obj["expected_candidates"], _text, False),
              expected_incumbents=_array(obj["expected_incumbents"], _text, False),
              required_baselines=_array(obj["required_baselines"], lambda value: _enum(value, BaselineLabel), False),
              bakeoff_gate=_boolean(obj["bakeoff_gate"]),
              report_timeout_ns=(lambda value: _integer(value, 1))(obj["report_timeout_ns"]),
              max_diagnostic_bytes=(lambda value: _integer(value, 1))(obj["max_diagnostic_bytes"]),
          )
          _validate_batch(result)
          return result

  class ReservationReceipt:
      binding: AttemptBinding
      filesystems: list[ReservedFilesystem]
      free_samples: list[FreeSample]
  
      @classmethod
      def from_json(cls, raw: object) -> Outcome[Self]:
          return _decode(raw, cls._parse)
  
      @classmethod
      def _parse(cls, raw: object) -> Self:
          obj = _object(raw, ("binding", "filesystems", "free_samples"))
          result = cls(
              binding=AttemptBinding._parse(obj["binding"]),
              filesystems=_array(obj["filesystems"], ReservedFilesystem._parse, True),
              free_samples=_array(obj["free_samples"], FreeSample._parse, True),
          )
          _unique([f.device for f in result.filesystems], "reserved device")
          _ordered([f.at_ns for f in result.free_samples], "free sample timestamps")
          return result
